aboutTeaser.title: BYTI is a <accent>multinational</accent>
aboutTeaser.body: BYTI is a multinational with operations across several continents, with offices in China, Dubai, Abidjan and Cameroon. Through its subsidiary BYTI Technologie SARL, the group delivers a complete offering in Central Africa: electronics, security, energy, televisions and construction materials, combining international standards with local roots.

manufacturing.desc: BYTI relies on a network of cutting-edge gigafactories in China to produce LiFePO₄ batteries for domestic and industrial use, delivered across Africa.

items.title: Automated assembly lines
items.text: Robotic lines produce high-density LiFePO₄ cells with millimeter precision, ensuring performance and longevity.

items.title: Quality control in a clean room
items.text: Every module is inspected by our technicians in an ultra-controlled environment before being integrated into our energy solutions.

items.title: From home to industry
items.text: From residential powerwalls to multi-MWh storage containers, BYTI provides solutions at every scale, all across Africa.

electronicsShowcase.desc: BYTI works directly with the largest manufacturing plants in China to offer you certified authentic smartphones, tablets and electronic accessories.

items.title: Next-generation smartphones
items.text: Robotic assembly lines continuously produce smartphones, tablets and accessories under strict quality control.

items.title: Boards & microcomponents
items.text: High-precision SMT lines for soldering miniaturized components: reliability starts at the board level.

items.title: Premium selection for you
items.text: BYTI selects and distributes the best connected electronic devices: smartphones, tablets, watches and audio.

energyShowcase.desc: Portable stations, solar inverters and LiFePO₄ lithium batteries certified by BYTI. Built to last, designed to endure.
